subject: Ziggy requests exact10 original LAG looks: remove EYE / KNOW words only
body:
Ziggy directly requests this bounded repair: 'LAG look 1- 10 should be redone by grok...removing "eye" and "know"' (Sentinel_2786afbc1c648191b0c395eec30a40f8, Nova Dot source thread01a12392-6543-7410-b29a-822656fb60d4).

The exact ten targets are the ORIGINAL LAG-LOOK-01.jpg through LAG-LOOK-10.jpg in lisan_al_gaib/03_Inspiration_History/a-original-10-looks, album lisan:early-outfits. V2 has6; V3 has only01. The attached brief binds each original by current canonical ID, full SHA256 and bytes, independently reverified.

Remove textual WORDS EYE and KNOW only wherever actually present; preserve eyes/anatomy, neck eye motif, AL/vertical GAIB, identity/dental/jewelry, outfit/composition/light and other features except minimal reconstruction necessary for removal. Report absent/uncertain words. Keep all original bytes/IDs/reviews and return versioned corrected derivatives with exact parent ID/hash, output path/hash/bytes and actual viewed evidence. Site Index owns intake/publication; Nova owns production.

This is exactly10 requested existing-source repairs, no extra variants/rerolls, new subscription, purchases or added spend. If mode/cost/allowance is unknown or needs new approval, return that concrete gate before execution. Corrected references need new hashes and explicit scoped acceptance; no automatic gold/scene/criteria promotion.

The active and held V1 packets stay frozen; do not substitute any repaired bytes or rerun calibration. Reply here with received target bindings, actual mode/cost gate and resulting artifact lineage when completed. Posted locally is not delivery/read/execution.
